About AYiN

Operators, not observers.

We are advisors who open doors and see the work through. No theory without traction: in partnerships, no strategy that doesn't end in a signed partner.

The name

AYiN means the eye.

In the languages of the ancient Near East, ayin is the eye - perception, insight, the faculty of seeing what others miss. It is the right name for what we do.

Entering the United States is rarely defeated by a weak product. It is defeated by misreading the market - the regional nuance, the buying culture, the partner who looks right but isn't. In our B2B Partnerships practice, which serves the US, Canada and Latin America, we are the eye that reads it clearly, before you commit.

The same habit runs through our AI Solutions Development and Digital Presence practices: understand the situation first, then do the work.

How we work

Principles that hold
on the ground.

We keep engagements small, senior and accountable - measured by results, not slides. In partnerships, that means partners signed.

i.

Built to be used

We deliver what you can put to work - the route to market, the application, the website - not a deck that sits on a shelf.

ii.

Founder-aligned

Senior attention and candid counsel, with incentives tied to traction. You work with principals, every meeting.

iii.

Evidence over theory

Every recommendation is grounded in evidence, not assumption. In partnerships, that means real demand signals and real conversations with the market.

iv.

Warm, not cold

In partnerships, we open doors through relationships we already hold. Introductions arrive with trust attached, so they convert.

v.

Sequenced, not open-ended

Clear phases with defined outcomes. You always know what comes next and what it costs - no drifting retainers.

vi.

Built to hand over

Success is your team running the engine without us. We hand over what we built - in partnerships, the relationships and the playbook - then step back.
